title: Prove the P112 support-thirty shortening contract is sharp
body:
## Summary

The general P112 support-thirty shortening contract is sharp. An explicit rational witness realizes the support31 equality left open by #3205 and #3207 as actual collectively independent pieces.

```text
five small pieces: support union = 31
six endpoints:    support = 20 each
all pieces:       rank = 11
P112 code:        rank = 8
combined span:    rank = 14
intersection:     dimension = 5
```

This works over every characteristic-zero field. #3205 retains priority for the support-thirty theorem; the new contribution is its support31 counterexample. The package contains the proof, literal sparse witness, exact receipts, source pins and reproduction instructions.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the prior root-frame relaxation reaches total endpoint cost 120 at 31 cuts, without an actual independent-piece construction.
  **After:** the new witness balances the six individual supports at 20, supplies five explicit codeword identities and passes collective independence checks.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes rational elimination, a separately implemented lattice/modular proof and fourteen optimized behavioral groups. The modular check uses nonzero minors for lower bounds and exact identities for the upper bound.
- Both checkers and all fourteen tests also pass under optimized CPython 3.13 from an exact, read-only, Git-free committed export. Archive integrity and all fifteen publication-byte comparisons pass at `4e31290dd10cbc443df8c7b9b1f66b82a4214bb4`. Ruff, formatting and source-tampering/output-path controls pass locally. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-support31-sharpness
```

The endpoint binary support-label ranks are 8,9,8,8,9,8. This witness therefore does not realize the original rank-six TWOSIDE pieces. No full C5, decoder floor, supplier or new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. Human/proof-kernel review and the inherited support-thirty theorem are outside this replay.

[Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19002155). Canonical main remained `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. The final paginated overlap snapshot covered 255 open PRs and 2,020 Discussion records with no warnings; the specific support31 search found the earlier equality controls and this investigation. This is not a novelty guarantee.

Credit Nick Petalas/#3205/#3207/#3203/#3188/#3176, DreamingOfClouds/#3154, and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. Exact heads and source hashes are retained in SOURCES.json. Development used substantial automated assistance; internal automated review found no substantiated objection.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new research package is added. Shared tools, predecessor sources and selected-frontier files are unchanged.
